link.name: Name

settings.soundsClaudeOff: Claude's sounds come with its notifications, which are off (Claude tab).
settings.shortcutToggle: Open the quick switcher with a shortcut from anywhere
settings.shortcutRecording: Press the new shortcut, or Escape to cancel
settings.shortcutHint: Hold {mod1}, {mod2} or {mod3} and press a key · {esc} to cancel
settings.shortcutNeedsModifier: Use at least one of {mod1}, {mod2} or {mod3} together with a key.
settings.projectsFolderHint: When no project matches, the quick switcher searches the folders in here too.
settings.scriptHint: npm script to run unless a project sets its own. Names starting with {build} are refused.
settings.openUrlOnStart: Open the browser when I start a server
settings.notify: Notify me when Claude is waiting on me
settings.fuelAlert: Notify me when the session or weekly limit passes 90%
settings.hookText: Claude Code doesn't write permission prompts to its session logs. This adds a {hook} hook to {settings} that leaves a note in {events} — it runs in the background and never slows Claude down. The file is backed up once as {backup}; nothing else in it changes.
settings.hookOutdated: An update is ready: with it, Claude's state shows here the moment it changes.
settings.extIntro: Pitwall works on its own. With the extension in your editor, the two work as one:
settings.extWhyServers: Servers started in VS Code show up here with their output, and a project started here runs in the window that has it open.
settings.extWhySeen: Claude's turn counts as seen as soon as you switch to its window, so no notification comes for what you've already seen.
settings.extWhyReveal: A Claude session clicked in the day view comes up in its own tab or terminal.
settings.extWhyProjects: Projects you open in the editor are listed by themselves.
settings.extVsixHint: {editor} installs it from the .vsix file: Extensions › ⋯ › Install from VSIX…
about.blurb: Your projects' dev servers and Claude sessions, one click away in the menu bar. Free and open source under the MIT licence.
about.bio: Mustafa Sarı — a full-stack developer in Ankara, building web apps with Laravel, Vue.js and TypeScript, and interactive canvas and WebGL interfaces.
about.supportText: Pitwall is free. If it saves you time, a coffee helps keep it going.
day.title: Where did the day go?
day.sessionTitle: Click to show this session in the editor
day.laneTitle: Double-click to open in the editor
day.laneKeys: Left and right arrows step through the project's day.
day.empty: Nothing written down for this day.
day.emptyHint: While Pitwall runs, it notes Claude sessions, dev servers and commands.
fuel.title: Fuel
fuel.gauge.label: {name}: {value} left
fuel.pace.title: This window
fuel.pace.out: At this pace fuel runs out at {empty}; the window refills at {reset}. For the {wait} between, Claude makes you wait.
fuel.pace.lasts: At this pace fuel lasts until the window refills at {reset}.
fuel.pace.early: Too early to judge the pace; the window refills at {reset}.
fuel.pace.empty: Fuel is out; the window refills at {reset}. Until then Claude makes you wait.
fuel.pace.idle: The window starts with your next message to Claude and lasts 5 hours.
fuel.today.unpriced: No price known for {models}; left out of the cost.
fuel.state.signedOut.title: Not signed in to Claude Code
fuel.state.signedOut.body: Limits are read with Claude Code's sign-in. Run {claude} in a terminal and sign in with {login}; this page fills in by itself.
fuel.state.expired.title: Claude Code's sign-in has expired
fuel.state.expired.body: Pitwall never refreshes it itself, as that could sign Claude Code out. Using Claude Code once refreshes it.
fuel.state.dimmed: The last values read are shown dimmed.
fuel.state.rateLimited.title: Anthropic isn't answering for now
fuel.state.rateLimited.body: Asked too often. Pitwall asks again at {time} by itself.
fuel.state.rateLimited.later: Asked too often. Pitwall asks again later by itself.
fuel.error.networkHint: Check the internet connection; Pitwall tries again by itself.
fuel.error.timeout: Anthropic took too long to answer
fuel.error.forbiddenHint: This sign-in may not be allowed to read the plan's usage.
fuel.error.serverHint: It usually passes in a few minutes; Pitwall tries again by itself.
fuel.error.badResponseHint: The usage data may have changed shape; Pitwall may need an update.
fuel.error.credentials: Claude Code's sign-in couldn't be read
fuel.error.credentialsHint: Signing in again with /login in Claude Code fixes it.
fuel.error.keychain: The Keychain didn't hand over the sign-in
fuel.error.keychainHint: If macOS asked for permission, allow it; Pitwall tries again by itself.
fuel.state.noLimits.title: This account has no plan limits
fuel.state.noLimits.body: Pay-as-you-go (API key) accounts have no 5-hour or weekly limits.
sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.subtitle: Claude Code · every project · live
sessions.subtitleLogs: Claude Code · every project · from the logs
sessions.listedOnlyTitle: Hide sessions in folders that aren't in your project list
sessions.noHook.title: State is read from the logs
sessions.noHook.body: For live state, add the hook in Settings › Claude. Until then changes can show a few seconds late, and permission prompts can't be told apart.
sessions.empty.title: No Claude session today
sessions.empty.body: Start Claude Code in a project and it shows up here: in VS Code, in a terminal, or in a Pitwall Claude terminal.
sessions.none.listed: No session in your projects today.
sessions.rowKeys: Arrow keys move between sessions. Return brings a session up, Space marks its project as seen, {open} opens the project, {copy} copies the resume command.
sessions.action.bringUpTitle: Show the session where it runs
sessions.action.reopenTitle: Continue it in a Claude Code tab in the editor
sessions.elsewhere.title: This session runs in {app}
sessions.elsewhere.titleUnnamed: This session runs in another app
sessions.elsewhere.body: Pitwall can't bring it up; it only opens the project. A running session is never opened twice.
sessions.limits.title: Bringing up is limited
sessions.limits.body: VS Code windows come forward; terminal tabs can't be picked on this system.
sessions.unknown.title: Where it runs can't be told
sessions.unknown.body: Pitwall only brings up the project's window, so a running session is never opened twice.
sessions.seenTitle: Seen is kept per project: marks every session in {project} as seen

sessions.seenOthers.one: Seen is kept per project: this also clears {count} other session waiting in {project}.
sessions.seenOthers.other: Seen is kept per project: this also clears {count} other sessions waiting in {project}.

sessions.day.none: Nothing written down for it today.
sessions.fuel.breakdown: Input {input} · output {output} · cache write {write} · cache read {read}
sessions.fuel.api: ≈ what the API would charge, not what you're billed. Subagents included.
sessions.fuel.unpriced: Some of its models have no known price; left out of the cost.
sessions.fuel.none: No tokens read for it today.
sessions.privacy: Message content is never shown: only state, names and token counts.

sessions.hiddenCount.one: {count} session in a folder outside your projects is hidden.
sessions.hiddenCount.other: {count} sessions in folders outside your projects are hidden.

sessions.unlinked.title: This {editor} window isn't linked to Pitwall
sessions.unlinked.body: Without the extension in that window, Pitwall only brings up the project's window, not the session's tab.
